tokens.name: page-bg
tokens.usage: Page ground, as rendered behind the page's content. Every text pairing below is checked against it.

tokens.name: page-text
tokens.usage: Default body text on `page-bg`: the colour most of the page's text uses that reads on it (10.8:1).

tokens.name: page-surface
tokens.usage: Surface most of the page's running text sits on (cards, panels).

tokens.name: growth-green
tokens.usage: Used as text on `.stat-icon.green`, `.btn-primary`. 3.5:1 on `page-bg` — large text (24px+) or non-text marks only.

tokens.name: warm-orange
tokens.usage: Used as text on `.stat-icon.orange`, `.compliance-deadline`; border on `.event-card.featured`. 3.3:1 on `page-bg` — large text (24px+) or non-text marks only.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Used as text on `header`, `.notification-badge .badge`, `nav a`. 1.1:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: medium-gray
tokens.usage: Used as text on `.page-subtitle`, `.stat-trend.neutral`, `.stat-label`. 2.4:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: success-green
tokens.usage: Used as text on `.stat-trend.up`, `.status-badge.excellent`. 2.4:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: warning-amber
tokens.usage: Used as text on `.status-badge.fair`. 2.0:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.
